images.description: Home with a titled conversation in progress: it leads Today.
Between server windows while the pendant streams: the Listening placeholder sits first under Today, not above the day list.
Streaming before the server opens a window: Listening / Live placeholder is the first row under Today.
The live page opened from the placeholder shows the title Listening until the server names the conversation (transcript bubble text renders as bars in the test font).
Server window opened but untitled: same slot, reads Listening over Live · 11m, never a date.
The server names it: Launch checklist in the same slot, Listening · 11m under it.
